amendments.cause: Fancy column indexing creates F-contiguous original readings; complete-row boolean indexing in partial_predict creates C-contiguous readings. Repeating PLS bank prediction on C/F arrays with identical values reproduces the last-bit discrepancy.
amendments.revised_assertion: Identical bank-bundle object and input readings, exactly one call to the frozen bank predictor, and bitwise equality to its result for the dispatched array are required. Direct original-array comparison uses atol=1e-12 percentage points and rtol=0.
amendments.tolerance_rationale: Absolute 1e-12 percentage points accommodates observed float64 reduction order roundoff (2.84e-14), remains 5e11 times smaller than the registered 0.5 pp scientific tolerance, and cannot conceal a substantively distinct reference prediction.

amendments.change: Reuse checksummed reports when source, locked inputs, template and demo trace are unchanged; guarded verification still forces generation once for a changed reporting implementation.
amendments.reason: Preserve verified PDF hashes across unchanged normal workflow resumes.
